# Large sets LS[N](t,k,v) from several base designs (Theorem 4.11 of the paper, an instance of Theorem 4.1).
# Points are 0..v-1. Permutations are given as image lists: g = [g(0), g(1), ..., g(v-1)].
# Each record: a line 'LS N t k v', a line 'H' followed by generators of H, then for each base design i
# a line 'K' followed by generators of its stabiliser K_i (none if K_i is trivial) and a line 'BASE' followed by
# base blocks; the base design is the union of the K_i-orbits of its base blocks, and the large set consists
# of all images of the base designs under H.
